text:
emma-partnerships: Quick kickoff — we need to finalize SKU tiers, trial flow, EULA mapping for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Propose sync today 1pm PT. Who's in?
micah-legal: I can make 1pm. Need to confirm data residency note for Azure and the SLA blurb. Also: any custom terms for marketplace vs website?
ravi-product: 1pm works. Packaging question: do we expose 'Pro' vs 'Enterprise' or bundle compute units? leaning toward SKU per seat + trial entitlement.
sarah-ops: FYI for Dedicated customers we need a separate entitlement path in listing metadata — IAM roles + onboarding link.
marketplace-bot: Checklist: manifest.json, images (1024x1024), trial SKU mapping, EULA URL, support contact. See https://go.redwood/pa/marketplace-checklist
emma-partnerships: Quick manifest snippet we should use as baseline:
```
{"sku": "redwood-pro-monthly", "trial": true, "entitlement": "trial-14d"}
```
micah-legal: For EULA: link to hosted EULA is ok for AWS/GCP; Azure asks for localized legal doc -> need localized version or stub. I'll coordinate with legal ops.
lina-sales: ping — does trial count as paid seats for metering? need pricing input.
ravi-product: lina yes, trial should not count toward billing. we'll set meter=0 for trial in the metadata.
sarah-ops: IAM: we'll supply a short guide for publisher-roles, vendor-account mapping. I can draft.
emma-partnerships: Can someone drop final asset list and EULA link by 11am? Otherwise reschedule. 
micah-legal: I'll upload localized EULA draft by 10:30.
ravi-product: I'll put packaging JSON + pricing matrix into the shared drive and post link.
emma-partnerships: thanks — see you 1pm. :thumbsup:
